architecture.mechanism: Closed-loop operator-state adaptation using a finite-state machine and composite fatigue/attention scoring from biosignals to autonomously modulate system behavior.
architecture.intervention: Apply a finite-state machine and composite attention/idle-score monitor (driver-presence via seat sensor/camera, door state, key-fob proximity, and engine-on duration) to the engine control module so that a sustained "attended idle" state transitions to an auto-shutdown state, while preserving manual remote-start and idle-stop cycles gated by authenticated operator presence.
architecture.expected_effect: Prevents unintended extended idling after shutdown request by forcing engine-off when the composite score indicates unattended idling beyond a threshold, without disabling normal remote-start or start-stop functionality.
architecture.falsification_test: On a stationary vehicle, simulate an unattended idle (driver door closed, no seat occupancy, key-fob out of range) for 30 minutes; verify the engine auto-stops within the configured threshold, while a second trial with authenticated driver present and remote-start command confirms normal idle-stop and remote-start operation still function.
